title: First Glimpse of Heavenly Secrets
next_chapter_hook: The Tianji Record itself issues a warning: 'He is not the final chess player,' implying the existence of a higher being behind the Eye of Heavenly Mandate.

text.content: The emissary's words were like a poisoned soft blade, silently piercing the softest part of Chen Ji's heart. The fire ten thousand years ago, set by his own hand—these eight characters exploded in his mind, stirring layers of ripples.\n\nYet Chen Ji's expression remained unruffled, as if the emissary's words were merely a boring joke. He slowly lifted his teacup, gently blowing away the steam, his posture so leisurely that even the emissary felt somewhat surprised.

dialogue.content: 'The fire ten thousand years ago?' Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice calm to the point of coldness, 'Esteemed emissary, are you certain you're not speaking in your sleep? If this one truly possessed such ability, why would I be reduced to living as atrash in the Tianqing Sect?'\n\nHe raised his gaze, his eyes like water, unfathomable in depth.

text.content: The emissary slightly narrowed his eyes, studying the young man before him. He was merely an servant disciple—yet why did his gaze carry a depth that made one's heart tremble? He tucked the emblem inscribed with strange patterns back into his sleeve, his smile deepening.\n\n'Mr. Chen is indeed no ordinary person,' he rose, 'This emblem shall be a gift for you, Mr. Chen. Someday, you will remember.'

Only after the emissary's figure completely vanished into the night did Chen Ji slowly set down his teacup. His fingers trembled slightly within his sleeve—not from fear, but from rage.

He was utterly fed up with being locked by fate, passively accepting prophecy.

'Since you claim I set that fire ten thousand years ago,' he murmured quietly, a resolute glint flashing in his eyes, 'then let me see exactly what this chain of destiny is made of!'

Chen Ji turned and entered the secret chamber, sitting cross-legged. At his chest, the fragmented Tianji Record Page faintly radiated warmth.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji decided to actively sense the rules of heaven, but there were multiple methods. He chose:

choices.text: Risky Opening of the Heavenly Eye
choices.description: Directly use the incomplete Tianji Record to forcibly open the Heavenly Eye, touching the threads of fate that bind oneself—extremely high risk but may obtain crucial information.
choices.visible_reward: May first actively sense the threads of fate
choices.risk_hint: Forcibly opening with insufficient Heavenly Fate may cause soul damage

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, his consciousness sinking into the Mental Sea. Using the incomplete Tianji Record Fragment as the core, he attempted to forcibly open the Heavenly Eye. A violent pain exploded from his brow center, and he felt as if countless needles were piercing his brain.\n\n'Mmph—!' He groaned, cold sweat seeping from his temples, yet the light in his eyes grew increasingly bright.

choices.description: First use one's own spiritual energy to nurture the Tianji Record Fragment, waiting for it to naturally resonate—slow but safe and reliable.
choices.visible_reward: Safely and steadily establish a preliminary connection with the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Time-consuming, may miss the optimal timing

text.content: Chen Ji did not rush for quick success. Instead, he slowly circulated his spiritual energy, nurturing the Tianji Record Fragment like spring rain moistening the earth. As time passed, that fragment gradually grew warm.\n\nAfter one hour, he sensed a faint, barely perceptible connection forming in his Mental Sea.

choices.description: Since that emblem is related to ten thousand years ago, perhaps one can find a breakthrough from it, returning the favor in kind.
choices.visible_reward: Perhaps obtain crucial clues from the emblem
choices.risk_hint: The emblem may contain tracking techniques

text.content: Chen Ji took out the emblem from his sleeve, examining it carefully. Strangely, when his spiritual energy flowed over it, he sensed a familiar aura—an aura remarkably similar to the Tianji Record Fragment.\n\nHis pupils sharply contracted.

The Heavenly Eye slowly opened, and Chen Ji felt the world before him undergo a sky-rolling, earth-shaking transformation. The originally dim secret chamber turned into a chaotic Void, with countless threads of light finer than hair intertwining and tangling in the Void, as dense and intricate as a spider's web.

Those threads of light—were the threads of fate.

He followed the thickest thread and discovered that its other end was connected to his own chest. And on that thread, densely carved with ancient runes, each rune emanated a chilling might.

「Is this...the seal of the Heavenly Dao's Eye?」 Chen Ji murmured to himself, his voice carrying a tremor—not of fear, but excitement.

Just as Chen Ji tried to touch that thread of fate, the Tianji Record Fragment on his chest suddenly shook violently.

A majestic consciousness surged into his Mental Sea like a tide—that consciousness was ancient, desolate, filled with the weight of ten thousand years of vicissitudes.

「You have finally chosen to call upon me willingly.」

That voice echoed in Chen Ji's mind, resonating like bells and chimes, shaking his very soul. He suddenly realized—this was the voice of the Tianji Record's main body!

dialogue.content:
「You are...」 Chen Ji forced down the shock in his heart, attempting to communicate with that consciousness.

「I am the Spirit of the Tianji Record,」 the voice calmly replied, 「and also the main body of the Tianji Record you speak of. For ten thousand years, you are the first to willingly awaken me.」

In that consciousness, a blurry figure emerged, that figure shrouded in endless mist, its features unclear.

choice.prompt: The Tianji Record's main body asked Chen Ji of his intentions, and Chen Ji chose:

choices.text: Directly question the seal of fate
choices.description: Demand that the Tianji Record explain why he was targeted by the Heavenly Dao's Eye, what exactly the seal on the threads of fate was.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the truth about the seal
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Record may not easily reveal all the truth

text.content:
「Since you can perceive my existence,」 Chen Ji's voice was steady and powerful, 「then I ask you—who placed this seal on the threads of fate? What exactly is the Heavenly Dao's Eye?」

The blurry figure remained silent for a moment, then let out a meaningful sigh: 「You have finally asked the right question.」

choices.text: Ask about the great fire ten thousand years ago
choices.description: The messenger said the great fire ten thousand years ago was lit by himself, this question must first be unraveled.
choices.visible_cost: May obtain a truth one does not wish to face
choices.visible_reward: Understand the layout ten thousand years ago
choices.risk_hint: The truth may shake Chen Ji's understanding

text.content:
「Ten thousand years ago,」 Chen Ji's voice tightened slightly, 「someone said I personally lit a great fire. What does that mean?」

The Tianji Record's main body fell silent again, this time for an even longer duration. When it spoke again, its voice carried more complex emotions: 「Some things are not something you can bear at present.」

choices.description: Regardless of the truth, first break the passive situation and escape the control of the Heavenly Dao's Eye.
choices.visible_reward: May find a way to lift the seal
choices.risk_hint: Forcibly lifting it may trigger more dangerous mechanisms

text.content:
「I want to lift this seal,」 Chen Ji's tone was resolute, 「no matter who placed it. I will no longer be a puppet of fate.」

The Tianji Record's consciousness shuddered violently, the blurry figure seemed to be scrutinizing him. After a moment, it let out a low laugh: 「You have courage. But do you know, once this seal is lifted, what will you face?」

At this moment, Chen Ji felt his consciousness being violently pulled by an invisible force. Looking along the thread of fate, he saw at the end of the thread, a gigantic eye slowly opening in the Void.

That eye had no pupil, only endless darkness, yet Chen Ji felt a fear of being completely seen through.

「It has discovered me...」 Chen Ji's heart tightened.

However, just as that Heavenly Dao's Eye was about to lock onto him, the Tianji Record's main body suddenly erupted with a powerful force, pulling Chen Ji's consciousness back.

dialogue.content:
「Now is not the time,」 the Tianji Record's voice became urgent, 「its gaze has turned to you. If you continue, you will be exposed under its watch.」

Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, finding himself back in the secret chamber. The Tianji Record Fragment on his chest vibrated violently, the characters upon it seemed to be rearranging themselves.

And within those characters, Chen Ji faintly saw several newly emerging ancient characters—

「He...is not the final chess player.」

text.content:
Chen Ji stared fixedly at those newly emerging ancient characters, his heart churning like mighty waves. The Heavenly Dao's Eye was not the final chess player? Then behind it, what kind of existence was there?

He took a deep breath and took out the badge from his sleeve. Strangely, the patterns on the badge were now faintly glowing, as if responding to the vibration of the Tianji Record Fragment.

「Indeed, there is a connection...」 Chen Ji murmured, a flash of understanding in his eyes.

He began to pour spiritual energy into the badge, attempting to trace its origin. As the spiritual energy flowed, the patterns on the badge transformed into a screen of light, slowly unfurling before Chen Ji—

choice.prompt: The light screen unfolded, and Chen Ji saw a blurry image. He decided:

choices.text: Forcefully trace the truth of the image
choices.description: Regardless of consuming more Heavenly Fate Value, he must see the full content of that image.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 15 points of Heavenly Fate Value
choices.visible_reward: See clearly the truth of the fire ten thousand years ago
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Value may drop to dangerous levels

text.content:
Chen Ji gritted his teeth, pouring a large amount of Heavenly Fate Value into the medallion. The intense pain came again, but he stared fixedly at the light screen, his pupils reflecting increasingly clear images—

Flames soaring to the sky.

A figure standing in the sea of fire, that figure... was identical to Chen Ji.

choices.text: Stabilize the mind and examine slowly
choices.description: Not in a hurry, first remember the existing clues and wait for a better opportunity.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, leave room for later arrangements
choices.risk_hint: The image may disappear at any moment

text.content:
Chen Ji forcibly suppressed his urgent heart, controlling the flow of spiritual energy with a calm will. Though the image in the light screen was blurry, the key information gradually became clear—

That figure was not setting the fire, but... protecting something.

Within the flames, countless runes could be vaguely seen flowing in the air, forming a massive formation.

choices.text: Verify through resonance with the Tianji Record
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record Fragment and the medallion to resonate, double-verify the authenticity of the information.

text.content:
Chen Ji pressed the Tianji Record Fragment against the medallion. The moment they touched, light blazed brilliantly. A stream of information flooded into his mind simultaneously—

This was no ordinary formation.

This was a sealing array.

The fire ten thousand years ago was not destruction, but... sealing!

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The fire ten thousand years ago was sealing, not destruction? Then what was sealed?

He suddenly remembered the line that appeared on the Tianji Record's body—'He is not the final chess player.'

If the Heavenly Eye was not the final chess player, then what was sealed ten thousand years ago... could it be its master?

'So that's how it is...' Chen Ji murmured softly, a bitter smile appearing at the corner of his lips, 'So I, or rather that "I", was sealing some terrifying existence.'

And now, that seal seems to have a problem. The Heavenly Eye has begun surveilling him—does that mean... the seal is loosening?

Just as Chen Ji's thoughts were in turmoil, the Tianji Record Fragment trembled again. The voice of the Tianji Record's main body rang in his mind, this time with a hint of urgency:

'You have seen what you should not have seen,' the voice said, 'From now on, every step you take will be watched. But this is also an opportunity—when it watches you, it is also being watched by others.'

'Who?' Chen Ji pressed.

'An existence older than me.'

As the words fell, all the characters on the Tianji Record Fragment dimmed, sinking back into slumber.

Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes and found dawn breaking beyond the window. He had sat in the secret room all night, yet felt no fatigue—or rather, he had no mind to care about such things.

The Heavenly Eye is not the final chess player.

The fire ten thousand years ago was sealing, not destruction.

There exists something older than the Heavenly Eye.

These pieces of information collided endlessly in his mind, sparking layers of sparks. A cold smile slowly curved his lips:

'Interesting. It seems this chess game is far bigger than I imagined.'

He stood up and tucked the medallion into his chest. Since someone had come looking for him, it meant his existence had attracted the attention of certain beings. Rather than hide, he would take the initiative.

'Since you all treat me as a chess piece,' Chen Ji said softly, a sharp glint flickering in his eyes, 'let me show you how this piece makes a comeback.'

dialogue.content:
Just then, knocking came from outside the secret room.

'Brother Chen, Sister Su has arrived.' A servant's voice came from outside the door. 'She says she has important matters to discuss.'

Chen Ji's brow lifted slightly, contemplating silently. Had Su Qingyao come because of last night's visitor, or was it something else?

He straightened his robes and pushed open the door. In any case, this Inner Disciple Senior Fellow's favorability was already high enough—it was time to let her know certain things—of course, just some of them.

After all, in this chess game, every piece has its own position. And Chen Ji will always be the chess player.

text.content:
Morning light fell, stretching Chen Ji's figure tall and long. His expression was as calm and serene as ever, as if last night's breathtaking induction had never happened.

Yet in his embrace, the medallion and the Tianji Record Fragment both emitted a faint warmth, like two hearts beating in synchronization.

The Heavenly Eye was watching him.

And he, too, was watching the Heavenly Eye.

This game of strategy had just begun.

What Chen Ji did not expect was that in the depths of the Void, an eyeless gaze was piercing through endless mists, looking toward his direction. In that eye, a trace of... amusement even appeared.

'Finally... found you.'

That voice echoed in the Void, ancient and eerie, like a call from eternity.
